title: Hinomori Shiho — An Old Wish〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I think that's about it in terms of our schedule leading up to our next show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's start chipping away at our ticket quota tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to sell tickets every time now, right? It isn't going to be that easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's right. I barely managed last time only because Honami was nice enough to lend me a hand.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Having to do this each time might begin taking it's toll on us... Still...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is something you have to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because this is a part of what it means to be in a band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. This is one of those obstacles we'll have to keep clearing if we really do want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The four of you will be fine as long as you're together! Right, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's do the best we can, together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I absolutely don't want you to carry this weight by yourself! It doesn't seem right at all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I'm asking a lot right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I want you to understand.
We care about you, Shiho. All of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because you're our dear friend...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Or in this case, divide and conquer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori, Kohane, do you both have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Leo/need's gonna be doing another show, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in buying some tickets.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! This time for sure...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, here are your tickets.
The time and date should be on the back, so be sure to take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please...
For the love of...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can gooo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can really go! I'm free that day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How about you, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I should be free that day too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, can I invite Haruka and the others too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, but I'm pretty sure Ichika and Saki are inviting Kiritani right about now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Alright, I'll go ask her later♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, if Haruka's free to go, I should see if An can also join us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The more the merrier. Just ask and I'll get you the tickets you need.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You will?! Thank you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't thank me.
After all, we're the ones who need you to come see us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, have you invited Shizuku already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...? N-Not yet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
In that case, you should totally invite her.
She's been dying to see one of your shows.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can already see her screaming, “Shii!” at the top of her lungs. That'd be so embarrassing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shii...
You've seemed so down lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's bugging you? Something to do with your band?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you should talk it out with Honami and the others if you can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll understand if you decide to be honest with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know that I want to keep playing with them now. They even showed that they're serious about going pro with me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have no idea what's going to happen moving forward, but what they said couldn't have made me happier...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The four of us are gonna give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sh-Sh-Shii...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Shii, I'm so glad that...!
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's been there for me through thick and thin.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is my chance to show just how much I appreciate her...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try asking her to see if she can go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I wouldn't want her to get all mopey by telling her after the fact.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho, you're turning bright red!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? No, I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
